run.name: Eldorado Gold Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (EGO)
run.summary: Eldorado has profitable operating mines and reasonable reported leverage on an illustrative basis, but is spending far more than it earns while two projects start up. The credit view is cautiously constructive and depends on those start-ups. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is ELDORADO GOLD CORP /FI.

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash and cash equivalents. Undrawn is the reported available balance on the revolving credit facility (limit 600.0, drawn 325.0, letter of credit nil). Excludes restricted cash of 71.898 held in the project loan debt service reserve. The undrawn amount of the euro 30.0 million project VAT facility is not printed and is excluded. Accordion of up to 100.0 is uncommitted and excluded.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Trailing earnings, covenant headroom and ownership cannot be established because full-year 2025 statements and legal documents are not in the pack.
CP-1 main limitation: No full-year 2025 statements, so trailing earnings, trailing leverage and the full-year comparison cannot be built.
